  charStart: number;    // Start character position in document
  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

### 3. Frontend Comment Components

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentSidebar.tsx`**
- Main sidebar panel showing all comments for a document
- Displays comment threads with author, timestamp, text
- Shows replies nested under each comment
- Provides Reply, Resolve/Unresolve, Delete actions
- Polls for updates every 10 seconds
- Filters by resolved/unresolved status

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/AddCommentModal.tsx`**
- Modal for creating new comments
- Shows selected text preview with character range
- Submits to `/api/comments` endpoint

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentHighlights.tsx`**
- Renders visual highlights in the editor for commented text ranges
- Uses mirror-div technique for accurate positioning
- Supports active/resolved state styling
- Clickable to navigate to comment in sidebar

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/EditorLayout.tsx`** (integration)
- Coordinates comment components
- Manages comment state and sidebar visibility
- Handles bi-directional navigation (sidebar <-> editor highlights)

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

## Comment System Architecture Summary

### 1. Backend Comment Routes and Handlers

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/comment.routes.ts`**

The comment API provides these endpoints:

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/comments` | POST | Create a new comment on a text range |
| `/api/comments/:commentId/replies` | POST | Add a reply to an existing comment |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | PATCH | Update comment (resolve/unresolve) |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | DELETE | Delete a comment (author only) |

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/repository.routes.ts`** (lines 378-453)

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/repositories/:owner/:repo/comments` | GET | Fetch all comments for a document |

### 2. Comment Data Models/Types

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/comment-file.service.ts`**

```typescript
// Author information
interface CommentAuthor {
  username: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
}

// Reply to a comment (flat structure - no nested replies)
interface CommentReply {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "r-{id}"
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// Main comment entity
interface DocumentComment {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "c-{id}"
  charStart: number;    // Start character position in document
  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

### 3. Frontend Comment Components

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentSidebar.tsx`**
- Main sidebar panel showing all comments for a document
- Displays comment threads with author, timestamp, text
- Shows replies nested under each comment
- Provides Reply, Resolve/Unresolve, Delete actions
- Polls for updates every 10 seconds
- Filters by resolved/unresolved status

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/AddCommentModal.tsx`**
- Modal for creating new comments
- Shows selected text preview with character range
- Submits to `/api/comments` endpoint

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentHighlights.tsx`**
- Renders visual highlights in the editor for commented text ranges
- Uses mirror-div technique for accurate positioning
- Supports active/resolved state styling
- Clickable to navigate to comment in sidebar

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/EditorLayout.tsx`** (integration)
- Coordinates comment components
- Manages comment state and sidebar visibility
- Handles bi-directional navigation (sidebar <-> editor highlights)

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

### 2. Comment Data Models/Types

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/comment-file.service.ts`**

```typescript
// Author information
interface CommentAuthor {
  username: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
}

// Reply to a comment (flat structure - no nested replies)
interface CommentReply {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "r-{id}"
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// Main comment entity
interface DocumentComment {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "c-{id}"
  charStart: number;    // Start character position in document
  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentSidebar.tsx`**
- Main sidebar panel showing all comments for a document
- Displays comment threads with author, timestamp, text

- Modal for creating new comments

- Renders visual highlights in the editor for commented text ranges

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

  avatarUrl: string | null;
}

// Reply to a comment (flat structure - no nested replies)

  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}

- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml

version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z

        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

### 2. Comment Data Models/Types

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/comment-file.service.ts`**

```typescript
// Author information
interface CommentAuthor {
  username: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
}

// Reply to a comment (flat structure - no nested replies)
interface CommentReply {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "r-{id}"
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// Main comment entity
interface DocumentComment {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "c-{id}"
  charStart: number;    // Start character position in document
  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

## Comment System Architecture Summary

### 1. Backend Comment Routes and Handlers

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/comment.routes.ts`**

The comment API provides these endpoints:

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/comments` | POST | Create a new comment on a text range |
| `/api/comments/:commentId/replies` | POST | Add a reply to an existing comment |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | PATCH | Update comment (resolve/unresolve) |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | DELETE | Delete a comment (author only) |

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/repository.routes.ts`** (lines 378-453)

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/repositories/:owner/:repo/comments` | GET | Fetch all comments for a document |

### 2. Comment Data Models/Types

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/comment-file.service.ts`**

```typescript
// Author information
interface CommentAuthor {
  username: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
}

// Reply to a comment (flat structure - no nested replies)
interface CommentReply {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "r-{id}"
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// Main comment entity
interface DocumentComment {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "c-{id}"
  charStart: number;    // Start character position in document
  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

### 3. Frontend Comment Components

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentSidebar.tsx`**
- Main sidebar panel showing all comments for a document
- Displays comment threads with author, timestamp, text
- Shows replies nested under each comment
- Provides Reply, Resolve/Unresolve, Delete actions
- Polls for updates every 10 seconds
- Filters by resolved/unresolved status

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/AddCommentModal.tsx`**
- Modal for creating new comments
- Shows selected text preview with character range
- Submits to `/api/comments` endpoint

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentHighlights.tsx`**
- Renders visual highlights in the editor for commented text ranges
- Uses mirror-div technique for accurate positioning
- Supports active/resolved state styling
- Clickable to navigate to comment in sidebar

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/EditorLayout.tsx`** (integration)
- Coordinates comment components
- Manages comment state and sidebar visibility
- Handles bi-directional navigation (sidebar <-> editor highlights)

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

## Comment System Architecture Summary

### 1. Backend Comment Routes and Handlers

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/comment.routes.ts`**

The comment API provides these endpoints:

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/comments` | POST | Create a new comment on a text range |
| `/api/comments/:commentId/replies` | POST | Add a reply to an existing comment |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | PATCH | Update comment (resolve/unresolve) |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | DELETE | Delete a comment (author only) |

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/repository.routes.ts`** (lines 378-453)

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/repositories/:owner/:repo/comments` | GET | Fetch all comments for a document |

### 2. Comment Data Models/Types

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/comment-file.service.ts`**

```typescript
// Author information
interface CommentAuthor {
  username: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
}

// Reply to a comment (flat structure - no nested replies)
interface CommentReply {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "r-{id}"
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// Main comment entity
interface DocumentComment {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "c-{id}"
  charStart: number;    // Start character position in document
  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

### 3. Frontend Comment Components

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentSidebar.tsx`**
- Main sidebar panel showing all comments for a document
- Displays comment threads with author, timestamp, text
- Shows replies nested under each comment
- Provides Reply, Resolve/Unresolve, Delete actions
- Polls for updates every 10 seconds
- Filters by resolved/unresolved status

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/AddCommentModal.tsx`**
- Modal for creating new comments
- Shows selected text preview with character range
- Submits to `/api/comments` endpoint

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentHighlights.tsx`**
- Renders visual highlights in the editor for commented text ranges
- Uses mirror-div technique for accurate positioning
- Supports active/resolved state styling
- Clickable to navigate to comment in sidebar

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/EditorLayout.tsx`** (integration)
- Coordinates comment components
- Manages comment state and sidebar visibility
- Handles bi-directional navigation (sidebar <-> editor highlights)

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

### 3. Frontend Comment Components

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentSidebar.tsx`**
- Main sidebar panel showing all comments for a document
- Displays comment threads with author, timestamp, text
- Shows replies nested under each comment

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "r-{id}"
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// Main comment entity
interface DocumentComment {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "c-{id}"
  charStart: number;    // Start character position in document
  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

### 3. Frontend Comment Components

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentSidebar.tsx`**
- Main sidebar panel showing all comments for a document
- Displays comment threads with author, timestamp, text
- Shows replies nested under each comment
- Provides Reply, Resolve/Unresolve, Delete actions
- Polls for updates every 10 seconds
- Filters by resolved/unresolved status

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/AddCommentModal.tsx`**
- Modal for creating new comments
- Shows selected text preview with character range
- Submits to `/api/comments` endpoint

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentHighlights.tsx`**
- Renders visual highlights in the editor for commented text ranges
- Uses mirror-div technique for accurate positioning
- Supports active/resolved state styling
- Clickable to navigate to comment in sidebar

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/EditorLayout.tsx`** (integration)
- Coordinates comment components
- Manages comment state and sidebar visibility
- Handles bi-directional navigation (sidebar <-> editor highlights)

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false

        author:

        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

  updatedAt: string;

}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}

- Modal for creating new comments

- Renders visual highlights in the editor for commented text ranges

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

## Comment System Architecture Summary

### 1. Backend Comment Routes and Handlers

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/comment.routes.ts`**

The comment API provides these endpoints:

|----------|--------|-------------|

| `/api/comments/:commentId` | PATCH | Update comment (resolve/unresolve) |

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/repositories/:owner/:repo/comments` | GET | Fetch all comments for a document |

### 2. Comment Data Models/Types

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/comment-file.service.ts`**

```typescript
// Author information
interface CommentAuthor {
  username: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
}

// Reply to a comment (flat structure - no nested replies)
interface CommentReply {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "r-{id}"
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// Main comment entity
interface DocumentComment {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "c-{id}"
  charStart: number;    // Start character position in document
  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

- Renders visual highlights in the editor for commented text ranges
- Uses mirror-div technique for accurate positioning
- Supports active/resolved state styling
- Clickable to navigate to comment in sidebar

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/EditorLayout.tsx`** (integration)
- Coordinates comment components
- Manages comment state and sidebar visibility
- Handles bi-directional navigation (sidebar <-> editor highlights)

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

## Comment System Architecture Summary

### 1. Backend Comment Routes and Handlers

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/comment.routes.ts`**

The comment API provides these endpoints:

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/comments` | POST | Create a new comment on a text range |
| `/api/comments/:commentId/replies` | POST | Add a reply to an existing comment |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | PATCH | Update comment (resolve/unresolve) |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | DELETE | Delete a comment (author only) |

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/repository.routes.ts`** (lines 378-453)

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/repositories/:owner/:repo/comments` | GET | Fetch all comments for a document |

### 2. Comment Data Models/Types

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/comment-file.service.ts`**

```typescript
// Author information
interface CommentAuthor {
  username: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
}

// Reply to a comment (flat structure - no nested replies)
interface CommentReply {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "r-{id}"
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// Main comment entity
interface DocumentComment {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "c-{id}"
  charStart: number;    // Start character position in document
  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

- Polls for updates every 10 seconds

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

## Comment System Architecture Summary

### 1. Backend Comment Routes and Handlers

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/comment.routes.ts`**

The comment API provides these endpoints:

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/comments` | POST | Create a new comment on a text range |
| `/api/comments/:commentId/replies` | POST | Add a reply to an existing comment |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | PATCH | Update comment (resolve/unresolve) |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | DELETE | Delete a comment (author only) |

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/repository.routes.ts`** (lines 378-453)

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/repositories/:owner/:repo/comments` | GET | Fetch all comments for a document |

### 2. Comment Data Models/Types

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/comment-file.service.ts`**

```typescript
// Author information
interface CommentAuthor {
  username: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
}

// Reply to a comment (flat structure - no nested replies)
interface CommentReply {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "r-{id}"
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// Main comment entity
interface DocumentComment {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "c-{id}"
  charStart: number;    // Start character position in document
  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

- Provides Reply, Resolve/Unresolve, Delete actions
- Polls for updates every 10 seconds
- Filters by resolved/unresolved status

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

## Comment System Architecture Summary

### 1. Backend Comment Routes and Handlers

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/comment.routes.ts`**

The comment API provides these endpoints:

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|

| `/api/comments/:commentId/replies` | POST | Add a reply to an existing comment |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | PATCH | Update comment (resolve/unresolve) |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | DELETE | Delete a comment (author only) |

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/repository.routes.ts`** (lines 378-453)

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/repositories/:owner/:repo/comments` | GET | Fetch all comments for a document |

### 2. Comment Data Models/Types

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/comment-file.service.ts`**

```typescript
// Author information
interface CommentAuthor {
  username: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
}

// Reply to a comment (flat structure - no nested replies)
interface CommentReply {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "r-{id}"
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// Main comment entity
interface DocumentComment {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "c-{id}"
  charStart: number;    // Start character position in document
  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

## Comment System Architecture Summary

### 1. Backend Comment Routes and Handlers

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/comment.routes.ts`**

The comment API provides these endpoints:

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|

| `/api/comments/:commentId/replies` | POST | Add a reply to an existing comment |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | PATCH | Update comment (resolve/unresolve) |
| `/api/comments/:commentId` | DELETE | Delete a comment (author only) |

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/routes/repository.routes.ts`** (lines 378-453)

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/repositories/:owner/:repo/comments` | GET | Fetch all comments for a document |

### 2. Comment Data Models/Types

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/comment-file.service.ts`**

```typescript
// Author information
interface CommentAuthor {
  username: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
}

// Reply to a comment (flat structure - no nested replies)
interface CommentReply {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "r-{id}"
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// Main comment entity
interface DocumentComment {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "c-{id}"
  charStart: number;    // Start character position in document
  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

### 3. Frontend Comment Components

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentSidebar.tsx`**
- Main sidebar panel showing all comments for a document
- Displays comment threads with author, timestamp, text
- Shows replies nested under each comment
- Provides Reply, Resolve/Unresolve, Delete actions
- Polls for updates every 10 seconds
- Filters by resolved/unresolved status

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/AddCommentModal.tsx`**
- Modal for creating new comments
- Shows selected text preview with character range
- Submits to `/api/comments` endpoint

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentHighlights.tsx`**
- Renders visual highlights in the editor for commented text ranges
- Uses mirror-div technique for accurate positioning
- Supports active/resolved state styling
- Clickable to navigate to comment in sidebar

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/EditorLayout.tsx`** (integration)
- Coordinates comment components
- Manages comment state and sidebar visibility
- Handles bi-directional navigation (sidebar <-> editor highlights)

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

### 3. Frontend Comment Components

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentSidebar.tsx`**
- Main sidebar panel showing all comments for a document

### 4. Comment Storage

**Storage Location:** GitHub repository in `.mume/` folder

Comments are stored as **YAML frontmatter files** directly in the GitHub repository:
- Storage path: `.mume/{documentPath}` (e.g., `.mume/README.md`, `.mume/docs/guide.md`)
- File format: YAML frontmatter + Markdown body

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/github.service.ts`** (lines 757-833)

Key methods:
- `getCommentFile()` - Fetches comment file from GitHub (returns null if not exists)
- `saveCommentFile()` - Creates or updates comment file in GitHub

**Example comment file structure:**
```yaml
---
version: 1
documentPath: README.md
comments:
  - id: c-abc123
    charStart: 0
    charEnd: 50
    author:
      username: johndoe
      avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/123
    text: This introduction could be clearer
    resolved: false
    createdAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    updatedAt: 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z
    replies:
      - id: r-xyz789
        author:
          username: janedoe
          avatarUrl: https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/456
        text: I agree, let me revise it
        createdAt: 2024-01-01T01:00:00.000Z
---

# Comments for README.md

This file contains review comments for the associated document.
Do not edit manually - managed by the collaborative editor.
```

**Note:** The archived SQL migrations (`003_create_comments_table.sql`, `004_create_comment_replies_table.sql`) indicate there was once a PostgreSQL-based approach, but the current implementation uses GitHub as the source of truth.

### 5. Real-Time Sync Mechanism

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/server.ts`**

The real-time sync uses **Yjs with WebSocket (y-websocket)**:
- WebSocket server runs on the same port as the HTTP server (default: 3000)
- Uses `y-websocket/bin/utils` for connection handling
- Document name is extracted from the WebSocket URL path

**Frontend hook: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/hooks/useYjsProvider.ts`**
- Initializes `WebsocketProvider` from y-websocket
- Handles connection status and awareness

**However, comments are NOT synced via WebSocket.** The current implementation:
- Comments are fetched via REST API polling (every 10 seconds in `CommentSidebar.tsx`)
- Comments are stored/retrieved from GitHub files
- Real-time WebSocket sync is only used for document content (Yjs CRDT)

| `/api/comments/:commentId` | PATCH | Update comment (resolve/unresolve) |

### 2. Comment Data Models/Types

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/api/src/services/comment-file.service.ts`**

```typescript
// Author information
interface CommentAuthor {
  username: string;
  avatarUrl: string | null;
}

// Reply to a comment (flat structure - no nested replies)
interface CommentReply {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "r-{id}"
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// Main comment entity
interface DocumentComment {
  id: string;           // Generated with nanoid: "c-{id}"
  charStart: number;    // Start character position in document
  charEnd: number;      // End character position in document
  author: CommentAuthor;
  text: string;
  resolved: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  replies: CommentReply[];  // Flat array of replies (NO parent_id)
}

// Comment file structure
interface CommentFileData {
  version: number;
  documentPath: string;
  comments: DocumentComment[];
}
```

**Key observation: There is NO `parent_id` or nested reply structure.** Replies are stored as a flat array within each comment. This is a single-level threading model (comments have replies, but replies cannot have sub-replies).

### 3. Frontend Comment Components

**File: `/Users/leewsimpson/Github/mume/apps/frontend/src/components/CommentSidebar.tsx`**
- Main sidebar panel showing all comments for a document
- Displays comment threads with author, timestamp, text
- Shows replies nested under each comment
- Provides Reply, Resolve/Unresolve, Delete actions

- Filters by resolved/unresolved status
